form.label: Proxy to Netskope migration readiness
form.description: Synthetic data. Run data-quality panel first; numbers below it are only as good as the feed.

panel.title: Data quality: volume drops / missing user

search.query: index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv | eval missing_user=if(isnull(user) OR user="" OR user="-",1,0) | bin _time span=1h | stats count AS events sum(missing_user) AS missing_user BY _time proxy_node | eventstats avg(events) AS avg_events stdev(events) AS sd BY proxy_node | eval gap=if(events < avg_events - 3*sd, "VOLUME DROP", null()) | where isnotnull(gap) OR missing_user>0

index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv | lookup app_inventory domain AS dest OUTPUT app owner business_unit AS app_bu migration_wave | eval app=coalesce(app, "UNMAPPED:".replace(dest, "^.*?([^.]+\.[^.]+)$", "\1")) | stats count AS events dc(user) AS users dc(src) AS hosts sum(eval(if(action="blocked" AND ssl_result!="handshake_failed",1,0))) AS policy_denies sum(eval(if(ssl_result="handshake_failed",1,0))) AS tls_failures sum(eval(if(ssl_result IN ("bypassed","not_inspected"),1,0))) AS uninspected values(dest_port) AS ports first(owner) AS owner first(migration_wave) AS wave BY app | eval deny_pct=round(100*policy_denies/events,1), tls_fail_pct=round(100*tls_failures/events,1), uninspected_pct=round(100*uninspected/events,1) | sort - events

index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv | lookup app_inventory domain AS dest OUTPUT app migration_wave | search migration_wave=1 | eval outcome=case(ssl_result="handshake_failed","tls_failure", action="blocked","policy_deny", status>=500,"upstream_error", true(),"ok") | timechart span=1h count BY outcome

panel.title: SSL bypass by app and exception state

search.query: index=proxy sourcetype=ssl_bypass:csv | lookup app_inventory domain AS dest OUTPUT app owner | lookup bypass_exceptions domain AS dest OUTPUT reason AS exc_reason expires ticket | eval exc_state=case(isnull(expires), "NO_EXCEPTION", strptime(expires,"%Y-%m-%d") < now(), "EXPIRED", true(), "VALID") | stats count AS sessions dc(user) AS users values(tls_version) AS tls values(bypass_reason) AS reasons BY app dest ssl_result exc_state | sort - sessions

index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv ssl_result="handshake_failed" | lookup app_inventory domain AS dest OUTPUT app owner | stats count AS failures dc(user) AS users dc(src) AS hosts values(http_user_agent) AS agents BY app dest | join type=left dest [ search index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv | stats count AS total BY dest ] | eval fail_pct=round(100*failures/total,1) | where users>=5 AND fail_pct>=2 | sort - fail_pct

index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv action="blocked" ssl_result!="handshake_failed" | lookup app_inventory domain AS dest OUTPUT app owner business_unit AS app_bu | lookup users user OUTPUT business_unit AS user_bu | stats count AS denies dc(user) AS users values(user_bu) AS user_bus values(category) AS category BY rule app dest | eventstats sum(denies) AS rule_total BY rule | sort - denies

| inputlookup bypass_exceptions | eval expired=if(strptime(expires,"%Y-%m-%d") < now(), 1, 0) | join type=left domain [ search index=proxy sourcetype=ssl_bypass:csv | stats count AS hits_30d latest(_time) AS last_seen BY dest | rename dest AS domain ] | fillnull value=0 hits_30d | eval finding=case(expired=1 AND hits_30d>0, "HIGH: expired but still used", expired=1, "LOW: expired, unused - delete", ticket="" OR isnull(ticket), "MEDIUM: no change ticket (no audit trail)", hits_30d=0, "LOW: active but unused - do not migrate", true(), "OK") | table domain reason approver ticket expires hits_30d last_seen finding | sort finding

index=proxy sourcetype=ssl_bypass:csv ssl_result="bypassed" | lookup bypass_exceptions domain AS dest OUTPUT ticket | where isnull(ticket) | stats count AS sessions dc(user) AS users values(rule) AS legacy_rule BY dest | sort - sessions

index=proxy sourcetype=proxy:csv | lookup app_inventory domain AS dest OUTPUT app | eval app=coalesce(app, "UNMAPPED:".dest) | stats sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out BY app user | eventstats median(bytes_out) AS med BY app | eval absdev=abs(bytes_out-med) | eventstats median(absdev) AS mad BY app | eval robust_z=round(0.6745*(bytes_out-med)/if(mad=0,1,mad),1) | where robust_z>3 AND bytes_out>500000 | sort - robust_z
